verdict.rationale: Working Copy is an interactive iOS Git client. Its documented automation runs on-device through Shortcuts and x-callback-url deep links, with Auto-Sync and Background Sync tied to the app running. There is no evidence of a headless mode, CLI, or way to run it in a CI pipeline, so these related automation features do not deliver this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
